thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx rate detected for /v1/generate in eu-west-1 — 12% error rate over 5m. Pager routed to oncall: sara.m

alex.k: seeing consistent 502/524 from edge-gateway-eu-1. Kernel logs show repeated TLS handshake failures like `tls: handshake failure` and `x509: certificate has expired` on leaf cert.

sara.m: paging oncall and posting to incidents channel. collecting quick impact.

jin.l: grabbing cert chain now. running `openssl s_client -connect api.eu.redwood.infra:443 -servername api.eu.redwood.infra` ->
```
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=2 C = US, O = Redwood Test CA, CN = Redwood Root CA
depth=1 C = US, O = Redwood Intermediates, CN = Redwood Int CA
depth=0 CN = api.eu.redwood.infra
verify error:num=10:certificate has expired
notAfter=Mar 11 03:14:22 2026 GMT
---
```

maria.ops: rotation job for eu leaf certs failed overnight. ACME logs show `429 Too Many Requests` during renew (rate limit). backup CA push didn't run because the `rotate-cert` job exited 1.

samir.s: immediate mitigation options: 1) push internal backup cert chain to edge, 2) steer eu traffic to us-east pool, 3) enable TLS passthrough to bypass broken edge (risky). Suggest 1+2.

alex.k: agree. preparing traffic-manager roll. command: `tmctl route update --region eu-west-1 --fallback us-east-1 --mode emergency --drain=60` (will cut new sessions in eu).

sara.m: executing routing change now. @deploy-bot mark change and pause nonessential jobs for 10m.

deploy-bot: Change created: INC-2026-834. Emergency route update applied. AutoRollback: true. Notifying infra team.

support: customer impact: progressive 5xx for EU customers hitting /v1/generate. We'll post a partial outage on status.redwood.ai for eu-west-1 endpoints. Preparing template now.

jin.l: pushing backup internal CA cert to secrets in k8s: `kubectl -n ingress create secret tls edge-tls-eu --cert=backup/fullchain.pem --key=backup/priv.key --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -` then `kubectl rollout restart deploy/edge-proxy-eu`. Doing it in canary 2 pods first.

alex.k: note: make sure `fullchain.pem` includes intermediate. last time omission caused clients to fail post-rotation.

maria.ops: confirmed ACME job logs: `Error: too many failed attempts, sleeping 1h` — rotation retry backoff was too aggressive. Filing bug.

jin.l: applied backup cert to edge-proxy-eu-01 and -02, restarted. logs: `INFO tls: handshake completed for client 10.8.2.14` and `INFO served request /v1/generate 200 120ms`.

alex.k: performing curl checks behind edge: `curl -I https://api.eu.redwood.infra/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer x'` -> `HTTP/2 200`

support: status page updated: "Partial outage affecting API in eu-west-1 due to TLS certificate error. Traffic being routed to alternate region. Workaround applied." :warning:

samir.s: monitoring metrics. 5xx dropped from 12% -> 1.1% in 6 minutes. continuing to watch.

sara.m: handoff plan: if stable after 30m, demote to P1 and create a postmortem. If regresses, escalate to infra pager. Handoff to night-oncall @jin.l for 45m.

jin.l: will continue watch. running synthetic against all edge proxies every 30s and logging TLS verify output.

incident-bot: Incident severity changed: Sev2 -> partial outage. Metrics tracking link: https://console.redwood.ai/metrics/incident/2901234567

maria.ops: created follow-up tickets: "ACME rate-limit mitigation" and "cert-rotation backoff fix". attaching timestamps and logs.

alex.k: quick note for postmortem: add a check in deploy pipeline to verify fullchain and ACME quota before letting rotation exit.

support: assembling list of top 20 affected customers to contact once we have full timeline.

samir.s: thumbs up :thumbsup:

alex.k: thanks everyone. will leave open until metrics stable for 30m and routing back to eu is confirmed.

incident-bot: Action items summarized: [1] Temp: backup CA push (done) [2] Traffic steer to us-east (done) [3] Fix cert rotation retry and ACME appeal (owner: maria.ops) [4] Postmortem (owners: maria.ops, jin.l)

support: I'll draft customer comms and CC oncall when ready.

sara.m: closing note: Great coordination — quick rollback path and backup CA saved the day. Closing once last_message_ts + 30m of stable metrics.
